sourceNotes.rawContent: Step into the 'Coquette' trend with our exquisite Gold Bow Pendant Necklace. This ultra-feminine piece features a fluid ribbon design that adds a soft, romantic touch to any ensemble. Crafted as a high-fashion statement, it's the perfect accessory for light-catching everyday wear. To preserve the brilliant golden luster of this delicate piece, we recommend keeping it tucked away in a dry place after your day's adventures and avoiding contact with perfumes or water.
